programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 武俠
programme.desc: Liu Jin-xi lives a seemingly normal life in a remote village. But his peaceful life is soon to be disrupted when a determined detective digs up his past.

programme.title: 追女仔95之綺夢
programme.desc: Dino Sau is a brilliant motor mechanic, able to supply a Mini Cooper with an engine powered by atomic energy. He falls in love with a beautiful, filthy-rich girl Vivian, but of course she already has a boyfriend. Years later, Dino is rich, and he meets his beloved again. She is now married to Gao Kun. Dino seeks the advice of an evil-minded guru, who implants him with dreams in which he can have his object of desire.

programme.title: 破墓
programme.desc: In Los Angeles, the renowned shaman Hwa-rim and her protege Bong-gil are commissioned with a hefty sum to meet the enigmatic descendants of a household afflicted by a peculiar illness. Sensing the ominous aura surrounding the ancestral grave, Hwa-rim urges for its relocation. The best geomancer in the business, Sang-duk, and mortician Young-geun, lured by the scent of money, join the team. The mysterious grave, situated in an unapproachable sacred ground, holds dark secrets. Though Sang-duk senses an ominous presence and initially rejects the proposal, Hwa-rim's persuasion ultimately initiates the exhumation, leading to a journey where the team must confront both supernatural forces and their own fears.

programme.title: 盲探
programme.desc: The crime-solver in the Police Crime Unit CHONG was forced to quit four years ago after he got blind accidentally and since then has worked as a private eye on cold cases to earn rewards for a living. He has spent nine months investigating the suspect for the Mongkok Acid Attack Case but was caught in a dire situation during an operation. Fortunately he was saved by a woman detective TUNG in the nick of time..

programme.title: 吹哨人
programme.desc: An earthquake of 6.6 magnitude strikes Malawi in southeast Africa. Eco Energy Technology, an Australian energy conglomerate with business in the region, sends its rescue team for emergency response. Meanwhile, in an exclusive resort in Australia, Chinese expatriate Mark (Lei Jiayin) runs into his ex-lover Wen (Tang Wei), now married to the chairman of Han Coal Group. Their old feelings rush back but soon he is dragged into something bigger with Wen... and turn into a night of passion, before Wen flies off to China in the morning. That afternoon, Mark is devastated to learn that the plane Wen took has crashed, with no sign of survivors. Two weeks have passed. Mark is trying to leave the past behind, when a mysterious call puts him in limbo. Mark discovers Wen cheats death after failing to catch the flight. Before figuring out the next step, they are tracked down by killers wherever they flee. Someone obviously wants her dead for good. Hopelessly outpowered, Mark pledges to pro.

programme.title: 衝上雲霄
programme.desc: Young pilot Branson recently takes over Skylette, his father's aviation empire, only to realize his old flames Cassie is a flight attendant there. Several years ago, he was forced to break up with her and move to New York to take care of his father's business. To this day, the two continue to harbor feelings for each other but decide to keep them bottled up. In an effort to rebrand the airline, Branson invites rock idol TM to star in an upcoming commercial and appoints Sam as her flying consultant. Incongruent in both tastes and experience, this odd couple gets off on the wrong foot. As the shoot progresses, however, they slowly discover each other's merits, developing a strong mutual attraction. Jayden has left Skylette Airline to become a pilot for private jets. He meets the young and vivacious Kika during a flight and assumes her to be wayward and shallow. But they turn out to have a lot in common and start falling madly in love. At the height of their romance, Jayden real.

programme.title: 一秒鐘
programme.desc: China during the Cultural Revolution. A prisoner escapes from a labour camp. He risks everything in his search for a stolen film reel in which his long-lost daughter appears – for one second. Soon he encounters the thief, an orphaned girl haunted by her own terrible loss.

programme.title: 超異能特攻
programme.desc: The five ordinary people, who developed their superpowers after receiving organ transplants from a previously superpowered being, fighting against another psychic, who also gained the power through transplant and covets their powers.

programme.title: 水餃皇后
programme.desc: In the 1970s, Zang Jianhe, a woman from Qingdao, was forced to leave her hometown with her two daughters. To make ends meet and raise her children, she washed dishes by day and cleaned cars by night. With no one to rely on, she bore the immense pressure alone. Determined to break free from her fate, Zang Jianhe decided to make a living by selling dumplings. From struggling to attract customers to eventually thriving, she received much support from tough-but-kind Hong Jie, Brother Hua, and Uncle Dessert. Through perseverance, she grew her dumpling business into a success, and her life gradually opened up to new possibilities... The film is based on a true story.

programme.title: 武替道
programme.desc: LEE Sam was the undisputed king of stunt choreography during the golden era of Hong Kong action cinema in the 80s. After a devastating stunt accident, Sam steps away from the industry for 30 years. However, his old friend, a veteran director, has now persuaded Sam to work as the stunt choreographer on what will be the director's last film. The only catch is that his film stars Wai - Sam's former stunt crew member who has since become a famous action star in his own right. Sam and Wai have a contentious history, with Sam's infamously overbearing and demanding personality clashing with Wai's own ego and ambition. By chance, Sam crosses paths with a young, ambitious stuntman named LEE Sai Long, who sees this as an opportunity to advance his career. Long is caught between Sam and his former protege turned rival. At the same time, Long helps Sam to reconcile with his estranged daughter, Cherry. As Sam returns to the world he once dominated, he must confront his past, mend fences w.

programme.title: 哪吒之魔童降世
programme.desc: The aura from heaven and earth has given birth to a powerful pearl inserted with huge energy. Yuanshi Tianzun (the Primeval Lord of Heaven) concocts two pills out of the pearl – a spiritual pill (Ling Zhu) and a sorcery pill (Mo Wan). He then seals both of them in the seven-colored sacred lotus. The spiritual pill will reincarnate as a man, who is destined to assist in the creation of the new Zhou dynasty; whilst a demon will be born of the sorcery pill, who is set to bring great destructions to the world. To prevent disasters, Yuanshi Tianzun has initiated a kalpa spell to strike the sorcery pill with thunder in three years. Facing the advent of the thunder, will Nezha still be the demon as destined? What will he choose.

programme.title: 哪吒之魔童鬧海（粵語配音版
programme.desc: Ne Zha returns again joining by versatile stars - Jennifer Yu, Fish Liew and Peter Chan, who bring their unique voices and witty dialogue to the adventures of Ne Zha and Ao Bing and breathe a new life into the story. After the heavenly lightning, although Ne Zha and Ao Bing survived by becoming spirits, they would soon dissipate completely. Taiyi plans to rebuild Ne Zha and Ao Bing's mortal bodies with the Seven-colored Precious Lotus. However, during the process of reconstruction, numerous obstacles arise. Together, they embark on a new journey to challenge their fate.

programme.title: 傷城
programme.desc: In a city of love and prosperity, a city of lost hope and premature death, veteran detective Hei feels it all: the hurt, the helplessness, the horror. When his father-in-law, the billionaire benefactor Chau, is gruesomely murdered in his palatial mansion, he enlists the assistance of his former partner turned private detective, Bong.

programme.title: 12.12：首爾之春
programme.desc: After the assassination of President Park, martial law has been declared. A coup d'etat bursts out by Defense Security Commander CHUN Doo-gwang and a private band of officers following him. Capital Defense Commander LEE Tae-shin, an obstinate soldier who believes the military should not take political actions, fights against CHUN Doo-gwang to stop him. The conflict between the two grows while military leaders are holding their decision and Defense Minister is gone. In the midst of chaos, the spring of Seoul that everyone longed for heads to unexpected direction.

programme.title: 猛鬼3寶
programme.desc: This anthology film features a triplet of horror stories starring up-and-coming actors and popular local Youtubers. When a film crew is haunted by paranormal activities, the director decides to cast her to play a ghost; When a taxi driver takes his girlfriend to a party room to get it on, a horny ghost adds spice to the proceedings; When a wandering ghost refuses to leave a soon-to-be-gentrified mall, the tenants concoct a plan to send her off.

programme.title: 女兒的女兒
programme.desc: Now a widow in her sixties, Aixia must become a mother once more when she receives custody of her daughter's daughter – in the form of a fertilized embryo left by Aixia's daughter Zuer, who tragically died in a car accident. However, Aixia already has a second daughter: Emma, who Aixia abandoned as a teenager, and the shame over abandoning Emma has never faded.

programme.title: 我的青春都是你
programme.desc: It's a romantic comedy between the next door neighbors Lin-lin Chou and Yu-ke Fang, who have totally opposite school performances. While Lin-lin struggles to pass the exams, Yu-ke gets the highest score in every of them. Just when Lin-lin supposes she is finally going to say good-bye to Yu-ke after high school graduation, they get accepted by the same department – department of animal husbandry, the most unpopular department of the most popular university. To fix Yu-ke's “First love trauma” she accidentally caused, Lin-lin tries everything to help him chase back his first love, the queen bee of the school. However, Lin-lin herself also gradually falls for Yu-ke during the process. What should Lin-lin do with her feelings? What is actually going on in Yu-ke's mind? The graduation season is around the corner, this is a story for you to call back your first love memory.

programme.title: 快樂到死
programme.desc: Bora Choi, who works at an English language institute, is having an affair with her ex-lover, Il-Beom Kim. Her husband, Min-ki Seo, is a former banker. He has lost his job, and has taken over the domestic roles of the house: cooking, cleaning, and watching the baby. In his free time, he watches soap operas and reads romance novels. Min-ki is aware of the affair, but seems willing to put up with it and to continue living with his cheating wife. Bora is disturbed when Il-Beom seems to want to take their affair further and pushes past her boundaries, risking to expose their relationship.

programme.title: 大風殺
programme.desc: The year is 1995. Mangya, a northwestern border town of China has become a ghost town since the once-prosperous mine and border trades shut down. The town has become an island, isolated from the outside world. There is only one police station with three police officers and one gun. XIA Ran, a retired soldier has spent over a decade here. There's a saying that he's the last survivor of the battlefield but he never talk about his story. Sandstorms hit the town once a year, and a catastrophic, once-in-decade sandstorm is forecasted for this year. The storm looms on the horizon; the final transport out of town has long left. In the dead of night, five corpses are tossed into the oil tank in the town's sole gas station. The piercing silence is interrupted by a pack of uninvited guests. However, what frightens XIA Ran more than the murders is that the gas station's tank has been emptied and the town's phone line has been severed. As the sandstorm closes in on Mangya, he realizes th.

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -怒火交鋒
programme.desc: “The Furious” Director Kenji Tanigaki, Producer Frank Hui and leading actor Xie Miao are invited to share their filming experiences. Frank reveals the best fighter agreed unanimously upon by five martial arts masters in the film. Xie talks about how he used punches to express the character's ruthlessness! Kenji also unveils the hardships behind creating one of the major scenes with 'five-person melee battle' in the film.

programme.title: 送院途中
programme.desc: After being reassigned to a new station along with his superior, Rock Sir, paramedic Wong Wai is assigned to ride with Jerry Ma. At first, Wai is worried that his work performance review would be affected because he doesn't agree with Jerry's way of working. But after some time, Jerry influences Wai to remember once again that the aim of paramedic work is to save every victim. Meanwhile, Jerry, a single father, is hesitating over the future of his daughter, Bonnie. He can't bear to see her leave, but he finally decides to send Bonnie to Canada for schooling. Before she leaves, she tells Jerry that she's worried about being forgotten when she's in Canada, just like her late mother was forgotten. Jerry tries to explain himself, but it's hard to digest such long-gestating grief. At the same time, a serious traffic accident occurs on Tuen Mun highway. Jerry immediately rushes to the scene for the rescue effort. When Wai notices that Rock Sir cares more about taking over command t.

programme.title: 爆谷巨星匯：周潤發: 別叫我“賭神
programme.desc: Water Ng, a typical loser who likes to gamble and takes no responsibility is asked to take care of his ex-girlfriend Jik's son, Yeung. With Jik tells him that Yeung is his son, and promised 100 thousand dollars, Water Ng agrees to be a father for one month. Soon he notices his son has Autism. He gets to understand the difficulties of raising a child along with special needs. With Jik's absence on the agreed date, Water Ng realizes why she brought him his blood. He finds his life goal while discovering Yeung's talent on the racing field, then decides to get rid of the dissipated life and accompany his son spreading wings for the dream.

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -拆解寒戰宇宙
programme.desc: Director Longman Leung is here to shed light on the mysteries of the “Cold War” series. What actually does the operation codename “Cold War” mean? Longman reveals that not a single shot had been fired in the first script while the foreshadowing in dialogue of 'Cold War' and 'Cold War 2' are going to be revealed in the sequel! Let's find out more behind-the-scenes stories of the “Cold War” series shared by Longman.

programme.title: 夏日大作戰
programme.desc: Worlds collide in a tale where virtual reality meets actual reality. When Kenji Koiso is pulled from Oz, a popular social networking realm, to play fiance to classmate Natsuki, he faces a mess of challenges. Between the boisterous and bickering characters of the Jinnouchi clan and the sudden chaos in Oz, Kenji and his new companions must learn the importance of coming together to face the toughest of odds.

programme.title: 戀之風景
programme.desc: Mann haunted by the death of her lover, struggles to accept a new life. She goes to Qingdao in search of the landscape that her love spoke of in his final days. There, she meets a young postman Lit who runs along with Mann every day in the landscape search. While Lit gradually falls for Mann's beauty and passion, she can only think of her lost-lover and the painting..

programme.title: 老鼠愛上貓
programme.desc: Based on the popular Chinese novel Qi Xia Wu Yi about the story of Judge Pao in the Song Dynasty and his group of heroic helpers, who together solve cases and catch criminals galore. In the original story, Zhan Zhao is constantly at loggerheads with Bai Yutong, a Robin Hood figure who assists Judge Pao from the other side of the law. Their conflict experiences a modern rendition in this hilariously iconoclastic film.

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -怒火交鋒
programme.desc: “The Furious” Director Kenji Tanigaki, Producer Frank Hui and leading actor Xie Miao are invited to share their filming experiences. Frank reveals the best fighter agreed unanimously upon by five martial arts masters in the film. Xie talks about how he used punches to express the character's ruthlessness! Kenji also unveils the hardships behind creating one of the major scenes with 'five-person melee battle' in the film.

programme.title: 片場職人 -霍佩詩
programme.desc: Ceci Fok, the art director of the film “Night King”, unveils how Hong Kong filmmakers create boundless imagination with limited resources, deeply deconstructing how to construct unique visual aesthetics in different film genres, the process of collecting props for the film, and how tedious work is transformed into endless fun, silently building passionate artistic dream brick by brick behind the scene.

programme.title: 毒舌大狀
programme.desc: In a moment of irresponsible negligence, sharp-tongued barrister Adrian Lam mishandles a child abuse case and indirectly sentences the innocent Jolene Tsang to prison for 17 years. Falling from disgrace, Adrian decides to serve the public and defend the commoners, until an unlikely opportunity for appeal surfaces. Determined to right his wrong, Adrian gathers former partners Evelyn Fong and Prince to free Jolene, but that would mean fighting against the tycoons, Victoria and Desmond Chung, who also have barrister James Tung as their private consultant. With pressure from media and police, and facing tough cross examination from prosecutor Kam Yuen Shan in court, how will Adrian uphold justice and punish the true culprit.

programme.title: 沉默的證人
programme.desc: A cat-and-mouse game unfolds over a single night when three armed criminals barge into a morgue, demanding the forensic doctor and his assistant to hand over a bullet lodged inside a corpse. While the criminals are in a desperate attempt to hide their true identities, the doctor finds himself sinking deeper and deeper into a quagmire as his past inadvertently catches up with him. Each explosive twist soon pushes the characters beyond their limits.

programme.title: 命案
programme.desc: On a rainy evening, a fortune telling master tries to help a prostitute avert certain death, but fate has plans of its own. He arrives at the prostitute's home just a few minutes too late, watching her take her last breath while Siu Tung stares at her corpse with creepy fascination. When he foretells that Siu Tung will soon commit murder, the Master believes that he has the power to change the inevitable. On the contrary, the veteran detective who once sent Siu Tung to jail for brutally killing a cat believes that Siu Tong is a born psychopath whose bloodthirst cannot be stopped. While Siu Tung becomes increasingly overwhelmed by his insatiable desire for murder, the Master puts his sanity on the line to change the course of fate. But is it possible to defeat the all-powerful force that paves life's path.

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -荷里活動作演員武術朝聖遊
programme.desc: Brian Le, one of the stars of the action-packed film “The Furious,” recently visited Hong Kong for a passionate martial arts pilgrimage. Besides visiting the 'Bruce Lee Exhibition' to pay tribute to the legendary master, he also visited a martial arts school to meet with Master Sam Lau, a first-generation disciple of Ip Man, and engage in a martial arts exchange! Brian will now reveal the highlights of his exhilarating martial arts pilgrimage.

programme.title: 非常幸運
programme.desc: Going nowhere in love and stuck in life as a lowly travel agent, Sophie finds escape in her own comic book creations. When she was winning the office contest for a prize trip to Singapore suddenly turns her life upside in the best way possible, as she meets there the man of her dreams: David, the handsome super-spy from her own comics. Before she can even get pack her luggage together, off they jump from the Marina Bay Sands Skydeck, and the chase is on for a lip-shaped key to the billion-dollar diamond called “Lucky Star Diamond”, a diamond capable of destroying the world, one country at a time.

programme.title: 重生
programme.desc: In a secluded corner of Mancheng City, a ruthless drug trafficking group stops at nothing to achieve their goals, leading to countless individuals falling into the abyss of shattered families due to drug addiction. Zhang Yao, who has been persecuted by drug traffickers to the point of losing everything, seeks revenge. He secretly collaborates with Captain An Du of the anti-drug squad to set up a ruthless trap to eliminate the top bosses of the criminal syndicate. However, behind this plan lies a carefully orchestrated game of revenge. Do they have the same enemy or do they each have their own hidden agendas? In this showdown, who is truly in control, and who is merely a pawn being manipulated? As the crisis looms, will they sink or awaken to reality? Proceed with caution as everything unfolds..

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 奪命金
programme.desc: “Life Without Principle” tells the story of three ordinary citizens, bank teller Teresa, triad thug Panther and Police inspector Cheung Jin Fong, whose lives are turned upside down by a bizarre robbery. Hammered by the predicaments of their respective lives, what are their choices between money and principles.

programme.title: JSA安全地帶
programme.desc: A firefight occurs at the 'Bridge of No Return' in the DMZ (De-Militarized Zone), and two North Korean soldiers are killed. The North claims that the incident was a flagrant attack by the South Koreans, while the South claims that one of their soldiers was kidnapped. In order to solve the dispute, the NNSC (Neutral Nations Supervisory Commission) dispatches half-Korean half-Swiss Army Intelligence Bureau officer, Major Sophie E. Jean. With no cooperation from either side, the case appears to be unsolvable. However, Major Jean discovers that the number of bullets fired from the pistols and the number found at the scene differ by one, and she begins to dig deeper into the backgrounds of the soldiers involved. Subsequently, she finds out about an encounter previous to the firefight when North Korean soldiers saved a South Korean soldier from a mine. The story unravels to reveal a friendship developed among the soldiers that involved in that firefight..

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 鐵三角
programme.desc: Life has not been kind to Sam, Fai and Mok as they struggle to make ends meet. Routine visits to bars seem to be their only way out of miseries. Until a stormy evening when a mysterious old man appears before them with a tip: An ancient treasure is buried under the high-security Legislative Building. All they have to do is sneak in and retrieve it; if they believe in his story. Sam, Fai and Mok agree to make a run for the treasure to test their fate. What they uncover is beyond anything they expected: An ancient coffin containing a ceremonial robe made of gold..

credits.director: 徐克, 林嶺東, 杜琪峯

programme.title: 信用欺詐師JP：英雄篇
programme.desc: The “Third Generation Tsuchinoko” -- the master con man hailed as a “hero” has died. Dako, Boku-chan and Richard all honed their skills under his tutelage. The title of 'Tsuchinoko' is handed down in secrecy to the Confidence Man (scammer) with the greatest skill, setting the stage for a showdown between his three star pupils. The contest will take place in the world heritage city of Valletta, Malta, an international gathering place for the rich and famous.Their target is the invaluable ancient Greek sculpture “Dancing Venus”, currently owned by a wealthy, retired Spanish gangster. Each scammer adopts a unique strategy in pursuit of the target, but the police and Interpol are also hot on their heels. Who will laugh last?! No one knows how the biggest scam in history will end! Who is the true 'hero' and what is the ultimate 'truth'? The last con game, grand finale, Battle Royale...begins now.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 葉問3
programme.desc: In the late 1950s, in Hong Kong which is under British colonial rule, Frank, a foreign property developer who colludes with the gangs and even the Police, is reclaiming houses and a school from the local community. It is not a good time for the Wing Chun master Ip Man to deal with young Bruce Lee who just applied for an apprenticeship. For the good of the people, he steps forward and re-enters the “battlefield”. In collaboration with another Wing Chun practitioner Tin Chi, Ip Man rescues the children kidnapped by the gangs..

programme.title: 無間對決
programme.desc: Major Crimes captain Park Kang-yoon (Cho Jin-woong) receives special funding to carry out his investigations and lives the life of luxury with fancy sedan, high-end condo, designer suits and accessories. A rookie named Min-jae (Choi Woo-shik) joins his unit, who happens to be very by the book. The pair becomes close as they begin investigating a new type of street drug, but Kang-yoon finds out that there is a mole within his unit, who has been compiling a case against him. As Min-jae is shown into the shady world of slush funds being used on cops, he is exposed to a secret organization within the ranks..

programme.title: 阿龍
programme.desc: Single father Lung and his daughter Ying are each other's only dependence. Despite the huge debt left by his ex-wife, Lung believes in good karma for good people, until he loses his beloved daughter in a kidnap while travelling in Thailand. Lung abandons all his faith. He marries a Thai Chinese, Lan, and starts a new life in Thailand. However, he never leaves the past behind. All these years he has been gathering information of the kidnap gang, and vows to take justice into his own hands at any cost..

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -危城自救小隊
programme.desc: In the film ‘Cesium Fallout', after an accident triggers a radiation leakage setting the entire city on fire, the fire brigade is tasked to enter the radiation zone and stop the hazard from spreading. The cast ensembles Ho Kai Wa, Tse Kwan Ho, Jeffrey Ngai and Lam Ka Hei as four firefighters, who will talk about their collaboration, unforgettable shooting experience and physical effort into firefighting action scenes.

programme.title: 焚城
programme.desc: After a fire accident triggers a radiation leakage, the entire city suddenly finds its survival hanging by a thread. In order to tackle the impending catastrophe, expert Simon Fan joins the emergency crisis response team led by Acting Chief Executive Cecilia to tackle this catastrophic disaster. With the lives of 7 million people on the line, the fire brigade is tasked with stopping the spread at all costs by entering the radiation zone. Facing this unprecedented calamity, will Hong Kong wake up to an overnight annihilation.

programme.title: 網戰特攻隊
programme.desc: Talented yet arrogant city desk journalist Lim Sang-jin investigates corruption within the major corporation Manjun, only to have his report debunked as a hoax, leading to his integrity being questioned. “Your article wasn't false. It was a trick that we orchestrated” Then one day, a suspicious tip is sent to Lim. The mysterious whistleblower introduces himself as a member of the online opinion manipulation team known as Team Alep, which fabricated both truth and lies for the right price...Where does the truth begin and the lie end.

programme.title: 紅毯先生
programme.desc: The Hong Kong movie star Lau Wai-chi misses out again on the Hong Kong film awards. He sits in his office, making short videos that pay tribute to the characters he has played over his forty-year career. But trying to regain popularity this way feels desperate and cheap. He needs to make a film again. He contacts Chinese director Lin Hao, as he wants to star in a film shot in the countryside, playing an ordinary farmer, something he has never done before. This film he thinks will help restore his career to glory. Yet he is so used to being a movie star and having a special treatment in his everyday life, that it is hard for him to connect with the people of the street or peasants, people who have a lower social status than him. Even with women, there seems to exist an impassable barrier. For his new role to be successful, he needs to learn from the villagers how they really live and speak. But they see through his arrogance and vanity – as does the crew. The big star is nobod.

programme.title: 我的幸福婚約
programme.desc: In a fictional Japan of Meiji Era, a time of remarkable civilization and enlightenment, people from families that have inherited special abilities [inou] have been protecting people from various disasters together with the emperor who rules the country. Miyo Saimori was from one of the prestigious families but born without the ability, and has lived her whole life being abused by her stepmother and half-sister. She is ordered to marry a ruthless soldier, Kiyoka Kudo, who leads the Alien Force at a young age, as a political ploy. True to the rumors that numerous potential fiancees had fled within three days, Kiyoka coldly told Miyo, 'You must obey me here. If I tell you to leave, leave. If I tell you to die, you die.” Miyo, who has no place to run away to, realizes during her stay at the Kudo household that Kiyoka is not the man he is reputed to be. Kiyoka is also touched by Miyo's thoughtfulness, and the two eventually establishes a special bond with each other. A light shine.

programme.title: 閨密盜賞團
programme.desc: In 1970s South Korea, women free divers who have harvested shellfish suffer a threat to their livelihoods after a chemical factory opens in their seaside village. Using their specialty in diving and knowledge of the waters, old friends Choon-ja and Jin-sook start to smuggle goods. However, when they find out they are being set up, they plan for the most mind-bending and dangerous job to seek revenge, which could become their biggest break-or the end of it all.

programme.title: 親愛的
programme.desc: When their son goes missing, TIAN and his ex-wife find their lives thrown into turmoil. Years later, they have been tipped to find their lost son, but he sees them as strangers..

programme.title: 火龍
programme.desc: The investigation of a prostitute homicide brings headstrong, heavy-handed Detective Manfred in an unlikely collaboration with sly, man-of-the-world Inspector Kee from the Narcotics Bureau..

programme.title: 聽見兩個世界
programme.desc: Dai is born to deaf parents and has been raised with deep love in rural Japan. However, as he grows older, he becomes troubled by his differences from others and begins to blame his deaf mother for his daily frustrations. When he turns 20, Dai leaves home for Tokyo as if to escape. Life in Tokyo was lonely at first, but when Dai starts working as a magazine reporter, he finds fulfillment in meeting a diverse group of people. Time eventually passes, and Dai returns home for the first time in eight years. Ah Tim has the greatest enthusiasm in his work, especially when he combs through the remains of the deceased and divests them of worldly items like gold fillings. However, his enterprise is spotted by Li, therefore, he has to make it a profit sharing venture. Later on, with the arrival of old Cheng, big fortune comes too. The two is now planning seriously how to get all the valuables from the big guy. However..

programme.title: 不老傳奇：杜德偉: 神偷次世代
programme.desc: Mac, a professional thief, and three others organize commercial thieves together. While stealing a cancer vaccine, they find a pre-set bomb which it is a setup against them..

programme.title: 靈氣迫人
programme.desc: Angie was an undergraduate from Canada who was in holiday in Hong Kong as well as doing research work for her thesis - 'Chinese Superstition'. She looked for accommodation and met Hansom. While Angie disguised herself as a ghost to scare Hansom, he was thrown out of the window by a genuine ghost. Detective Valentino came to investigate the accident and they unfolded the actual happening of the tragic evening when Singer Lisa Law had shot her lover..

programme.title: 雷霆特警
programme.desc: Zhao libing, an outstanding member of the Hong Kong special police force, was selected to attend special training in Seoul. During the training process, Bing met Li Ziping and Jin Yuqi, and instructor Zhang was very strict with them. After the graduation ceremony, Bing said goodbye to Qi and Ping and Cheng Zhengde sent her to the airport. They were busy with their jobs. Bing cracked a counterfeit banknote case in Hong Kong. One of the prisoners was willing to be a tainted witness and said that the mastermind was in South Korea. Bing accompanied with the Interpol to escort the tainted witness to Seoul..

programme.title: 龍鳳智多星
programme.desc: Taiwanese detective Simon visits Hong Kong and is served by Wing, the young and witty cop. Their adventures begin when they encounter two pretty girls, Pretty eyes and Slant eyes. These two girls are pickpockets and have stolen a jade from the professional killer. The killer is desperate to get back his treasure, that even though the detectives try to protect the sisters, the four are in great danger..

programme.title: 龍在江湖
programme.desc: Cheung Dee, together with his best friends Long Life Chuen and Holy Sand, set up a valet parking counter outside a restaurant owned by a triad society he affiliates with. By accident, Cheung finds out that the son of his triad head, Tai Tze, is fiercely attacked by Song Bo. To save Tai's life, Cheung attacks Song and not only leaves a scar on Song's face, but also puts him in jail for five years which plants a seed of the revenge five years later. Form that moment, the only person that can cheer him up is his best girl friend Ruby. Yet, Cheung has his heart on Sandy, a young solicitor who helped set him free in an assault case. No sooner has their love relationship developed than Cheung's nightmare has begun.....

programme.title: 林世榮
programme.desc: Lam sai-wing is the mischievous student of Wong Fei-hung. His eagerness to help others often lands himself in some precarious situations. He mistakenly befriends the only son of Master Kao from the Five Dragons School who then frames him for the murder of his God sister. Master Kao upon hearing his God daughter and his only son's death seeks Wing to avenger their cruel death..

programme.title: 鎗王
programme.desc: The key witness of a famous trial and 6 cops are assassinated. Miu knows Rick is back. Years ago in a shooting contest, Rick and Miu knew they were borne to be the sworn enemies.

programme.title: 最佳福星
programme.desc: The lucky stars reunite again. Having the new members joined in, they are playful and frolicsome as usual. This time, their mission is to investigate a case of international ammunition trade that involves two gangs. One is the Japanese underworld society that holds many stolen diamonds, and another one is the mysterious terrorists who own an enormous amount of ammunition. Let's see how the lucky stars overcome the danger and problem.

programme.title: 天地雄心
programme.desc: As Ken (Andy Lau), one of the surviving scientists, tries to solve the unsolvable, he is haunted by the reappearance of his dead finace Adele (Michelle Reis).

programme.title: 攝氏32度
programme.desc: A nameless hitwoman who, for reasons not entirely clear, has a lower than average body temperature. She is cold-blooded in other ways as well, assassinating her targets with steely detachment and having only two real acquaintances: the Cambodian woman who gives her killing assignments and money, and the street vendor Long Shek, at whose stand she habitually relaxes after successful hits with a bowl of noodles. Long Shek dubs her Pretty Ghost, and the two gradually become something like friends. Pretty Ghost ends up traveling to South Korea to assassinate a local gangland kingpin, a job she decides will be her last. However, the dead man's bodyguard, Yichin, is out for revenge and comes after Pretty Ghost..

programme.title: 摩登保鏢
programme.desc: Comedy trio the Hui Brothers' produce and star in this hilarious and off the wall laugh-fest and box-office hit, Security Unlimited. Michael Hui stars as head security guard Chou, whose unorthodox, and at times ridiculous approach to training his subordinates doesn't seem to go down well with his boss, Fan (Stanley Fung). Sam (Sam Hui) and Bruce (Ricky Hui) are Chou's favorite targets of abuse, but Chou soon finds the shoe is on the other foot when Ricky gets promoted after saving the day in a botched bank heist.

The killer is desperate to get back his treasure, that even though the detectives try to protect the sisters, the four are in great danger..

programme.title: 鬼馬雙星
programme.desc: Teng is the No. 1 con man plus professional gambler in jail. During the jail time, he meets young Liu and the two become friends. Once they get out of jail they team up to make fortune. The two gamblers try their hands at several profitable projects. One day, Liu hits upon a grand plan, but it needs a lot of capital. Therefore he decides to participate in a TV contest so as to win the money..

programme.title: 一觸即發
programme.desc: After police detective Lau is ambushed and killed, his best friend Pitt vows to get the killer. A series of investigation follows. Pitt finally finds an eyewitness to the killing - Fat Goose who is persuaded to testify against the killer Lam Man Fu. Lam Man Fu chases and attacks Pitt and Fat Goose. Finally, Pitt arrests him but Superintendent Keung frees Lam Man Fu and removes Pitt from the case. Then Lam Man Fu firebombs Fat Goose's residence. Fat Goose moves into Pitt's home and strikes a fast friendship with Angel, Pitt's reporter sister..

programme.title: 不老傳奇：杜德偉: 我愛一碌葛
programme.desc: Kudzu, Mud Carp and Bean depend on each other for survival since their parents died. Kudzu, the eldest of three sisters, gave up her studies and runs a fish stall in Luen Yee Hui market to raise her two young sisters. She is a super fan of the famous Singer, Alex. Mud Carp, the second sister, becomes a lawyer after university. Her boyfriend, David, comes from a rich family. In view of this, she dares not tell David her family background even though they are planning to get married. Kudzu always hopes her youngest sister Bean, to further her studies but she falls in love with a middle-aged butcher, Wing. One day, Kudzu discovers that her good friend, Keung, has a long-lost brother, and comes to the hopeful conclusion that his lost brother is Alex. In the process of helping Keung to find his brother, the relationship between the three sisters changed..

programme.title: 女機械人
programme.desc: Selina, a beautiful female cop, who is assigned to bodyguard a middle eastern prince who is staying in Hong Kong. But then, a mad scientist who has transferred his mind into a cyborge which looks human comes and kills Selina, then kidnaps the prince and holds him for ransom. To save the prince and stop the evil scientist-turned killer cyborge, good scientist Dr. Sara and her cyborge assistant Ann transfer Selina's mind into the body of a cyborge that looks just like her. Now Selina, Ann, Dr. Sara and Selina's cop fiance, who has been told Selina survived the shooting and doesn't know she's a cyborge now, must team up to defeat the bad guy..

programme.title: 不死情謎
programme.desc: Sam and his team are members of a Serious Crime Unit in the District Crime Squad, conducting a crackdown on an international crime organization trafficking in the human cargo of illegal immigrants. The team successfully dissolves the group and destroys its power in Southeast Asia. They arrest one of the group's leaders, Night. At the court, Night is charged with several offences and is being prosecuted by Sam's fiancee, Ann. Ann tries her best to convict Night for all the crimes he committed. However, the defense lawyer is tough and manipulative and finally, Night is convicted on only one of the charges in human smuggling and sentenced to three years imprisonment. Night is unrepentant and vows to take his revenge and destroy the couple one day. During the lawyer's visit, Night relays this message to his brother, Day, and asks Day to carry out the revenge for him..

programme.title: 同居蜜友
programme.desc: Tung Choi is the third-generation shop owner of a string of beef noodle restaurants. He gets into a minor fender bender with the hard working, yet outwardly mean Deborah. The two engage in an ill-tempered spat which makes both characters seem completely unlikable. Meeting later to negotiate a truce, the two end up engaging in a one-night stand, but a happy ending is far from possible. Tung is linked to high-maintenance TV personality Mindy, and Deborah is about to encounter a fitting fall from grace. Thanks to her mean-spirited behavior, she loses her job, her home (she and her father have a spat), and possibly her self-respect. Deborah and Tung encounter each other at the hospital, where Tung is visiting his mother and Deborah is staying (as in sleeping on the floor) with her sister. Tung offers to let her freshen up at his home, but she ends up sleeping on the couch for a short period of time. Tung's extremely weird family seems against Deborah; they tout Mindy's positive p.

programme.title: 富貴逼人
programme.desc: News reporter Bill and his wife live in a public housing flat with their 3 daughters. Their dream is to get rich someday. When Lady Luck comes knocking on their door one day and they win the first prize of the local lottery, Mark Six, all hell break loose..

programme.title: 影人映語 -李麗珍
programme.desc: Lee Lai Chun, a cinema goddess in the 1980s and 90s, has made her appearances in numerous Hong Kong movies. She seems to be a productive actress; but she admits that comparing to Carol ‘Dodo' Cheng or Sandra Ng who both has simultaneously worked on 9 film sets, doing 3 films at the same time for her is already exhausting enough. When she talks about the mode of filmmaking then and now, she misses and cherishes her family bonding with Tung Piu and Lydia Shum on the sets of the classic Lunar-New-Year series IT'S A MAD MAD MAD WORLD. Being in the film industry for over 30 years, though she has been awarded the Golden Horse Best Leading Actress, she regretfully says that she has not seen the birth of her own iconic role. Then, what does her ideal representative work looks like.

programme.title: 富貴再逼人
programme.desc: After he lost his chance of winning easy money in the original film, Bill became an editor for a newspaper and was sent to Canada for a story. What he thought was a chance to re-launch his career turned out to be a reason to get him fired. Just when the family has settled back down in Hong Kong, Bill's wife realized she has won the lottery in Canada..

programme.title: 城市獵人
programme.desc: Jackie Chan stars as the girl-chasing private detective Ryo Saeba in this hilarious live-action adaptation of the popular Japanese manga series, City Hunter. Hired to track down the runaway daughter of a publishing tycoon, Ryo ends up on a luxury cruise ship hijacked by terrorists. With the help from his jealous assistant Carrie, undercover agent Saeko and gambler Gundam, Ryo must foil the nefarious plot.

programme.title: 烈火戰車
programme.desc: Andy is a seasoned motor-cycle driver. His ultimate goal is to enroll in Grand Prix Racing. But in a private race, a severe crash almost took Andy's life..

programme.title: 影人映語 -詞「得」達意 - 黎彼得
programme.desc: Although a lot of people recognize Peter Lai mostly from his TV drama's performance, he is arguably one of the veteran lyricists in Hong Kong music industry. Looking back from ‘Choi San Dou' to ‘Monica', his lyrics have definitely contributed the success of numerous well-known immortals. Why would he become an actor while debuted as a lyricist? Worked with so many famous stars, what related interesting stories he is going to reveal to us.

programme.title: 嚦咕嚦咕新年財
programme.desc: Years ago Andy's passion for Mahjong cost his family their entire fortune, his brother Louis then turned against him. Thus now Louis suffers from economy downturn..

programme.title: 代客泊車
programme.desc: Stanley was an optimistic youth, feeling bored in his pig-rearing job, he decided to part with his beloved uncle and aunt and seek for an ideal job to achieve his own goal in life. He then found a job in Tsim Sha Tsui East. There he worked as a member of a parking service team and befriended one of his colleagues Ah Man. Ah Man was a reticent guy who was always frustrated by reality. The problem that he could not afford his sister to further studies in oversea puzzled him now and then. His anxiety was intensified by his sorrowful devotion to a mysterious beautiful girl Stella. Stanley was enthusiastic to help Ah Man to be acquainted with Stella. This made Ah Man live in high spirits. Stanley also encouraged his colleagues to work with enthusiasm. Their team was therefore rewarded with more tips by customers. A member of another team was a man of misconduct who stole spare parts and valuables from customer's cars. Mr. Yang, was a man who made fake banknotes..

programme.title: 天涯海角
programme.desc: Kelly, suffers from leukemia, encounters a sailor named Michael who comes from the North Sea of Scotland. Love comes and goes until Takeshi comes to her life..

programme.title: 阿郎的故事
programme.desc: Ah Long is a car racing fanatic who is in love with Ah Kar. Ignoring her mother's advice, Ah Kar decides to marry Ah Long. Tragic follows by this illegal car racing contest..

programme.title: 星影週末笑聲匯: 百變星君
programme.desc: Sing met Bonnie, a secret lover of a gang and is bombed for revenge. Only his mouth, brain and penis can still function. The doctor proposed the 'Sixty Million Dollar Man' plan..

programme.title: 黑雪
programme.desc: Maggie returns to Hong Kong to bring her grandmother back for settlement in Canada. Only her fiance Michael comes to welcome her back, but Jacky and Carol, her good friends and married couple, fail to appear. Jacky Chan, a cartoonist, is in fact a long-time cocaine doper and is therefore deeply in debts. Sam, one of the hired thugs of the drug-dealer constantly comes to collect debts. It greatly irritates Carol. Michael goes so far as to collaborate with the drug dealer for benefits. Moreover, he supplies cocaine to Jacky once in a while. Jacky is under the delusion that cocaine inhalation will help him gain inspiration in cartoon-drawing, but contrarily, cocaine only makes him get into real trouble. He resorts to satisfy his urge for drugs by snatching his wife's money and accidentally hurts her. Carol ultimately tells the whole story in tears to Maggie..

programme.title: 無限復活
programme.desc: Ren takes out his entire savings and persuades his best friend Sing to leave for Vegas with him. They challenge the most well respected dealer in town, and in just one round, Ren's wages is all wiped out. Ren and Sing begin their trip back to LA, but on the way their car mysteriously overturns and crashes, Sing is dead. Ren arrives home wearily to find a message on his answering machine that warns him not to go to Vegas. He decides to go back to Vegas to find out what really happened that killed Sing..

programme.title: 烈火戰車

programme.desc: The film was set in the 1970s, Dai Cheng-wah was a top law student in the University of Hong Kong. He fell in love with an orphan Suk-fun. His father opposed this relationship. The lovers eventually got married and Suk-fun dropped out of school because of pregnancy. Cheng-wah continued his studies and graduated. Under his father's influence, he was only able to work in a shabby law firm. After Suk-fun gave birth to triplets, Cheng-wah had a heavy burden. Finally, Cheng-wah won lawsuit and gained fame. However, Suk-fun suddenly discovered she had terminal illness..

programme.title: 男歌女唱
programme.desc: Chu Wai Tak is a natural born introvert, a white collar worker who suffers from a serious lack of self confidence. Her greatest achievement at work is 'using 10% less toilet paper than yesterday' and saving several more cents. King's self confidence is at its peak as he has crowned himself the King of Karaoke. He becomes exhausted if he does not go to the karaoke box and sing for a few days. King loves to gain attention at the company and has indeed brought a lot of energy to a boring company..

programme.title: 奸人本色
programme.desc: Leung Piu a swindler, cheats Yue Nan out of his life savings. This leads to Yue Nan's death, leaving his daughter Winnie behind. The Kang family, long disgusted by Leung's treachery, vow to avenge Yue Nan. They decide to “fight deceit with deceit”, exploiting Leung's greed to lure him into a trap, but Leung outsmarts Kang family. As the conflict escalates, Leung continuously sows discord between Kang's brothers Mon and Chuen. When Leung believes he has triumphed by triggering infighting within Kang family..

programme.title: 情聖
programme.desc: Shing and Betty want to find money to pay back the loan shark. They break into a house and prepare to steal the valuable items in it. Old Bill, who also owes debts to the loan shark, happens to be in the house. He pretends to be the owner, because he thinks Shing is a wealthy man that he could cheat him for money. Eventually, they find out each other's real identity and cooperate to set plans and trap the loan shark.

programme.title: 聖誕快樂
programme.desc: Knowing that Mak, the middle-aged newspaper editor often misses his late spouse, his beloved children persuade him to date Siu Fung, the singer who lives next door. At this moment, Siu Fung's cousin, Uncle Sam, returns from the states and proposes to marry Siu Fung. One day, dispute happens between Sam and Mak which makes Siu Fung so mad with Mak..

programme.title: 錢作怪
programme.desc: Ricky and Fatso are friends in need. They are in dire need of money since they are only paid slave wages at the bottling factory. By nature, Ricky is a dreamer. In his day dreams, he is romancing with Jo Jo, the movie idol. Ricky and Fatso buy a lottery ticket and become millionaires overnight. In one of these nights out in town, Ricky is suddenly attacked by an upset stomach. In no time, a quack doctor diagnoses the seizure as terminal cancer. Ricky seriously considers suicide. But he is also appalled by the drawbacks inherent in the many methods of doing himself in primarily the pain. It is on a rooftop from which he is supposed to make a plunge that he saves a poor man from suicide by giving the latter all the money he has. In gratitude, the newly rich man promises to hire a killer to finish off his suffering benefactor..

programme.title: 對不起，多謝你
programme.desc: Lee Lap Cheong is an immature, irresponsible and gutless guy who does not know how to say 'Sorry' and 'Thank you', a good-for-nothing who has completely given away his pride. When Cheong was still young, he married Yip Ting, who then bore him a son. As Ting grew older, she changed her outlook on life and realized that Cheong's love was not as important as financial security. She divorced Cheong and immigrated to Canada with their son Jason to start a new life..

programme.title: A 計劃續集
programme.desc: A group of Chinese revolutionaries are being bunted by agents of the Dowager Empress, and Jackie has to use all his courage, wits and physical prowess to keep the peace..

programme.title: 半斤八兩
programme.desc: Joseph Wong (Michael Hui), the kingpin of the Manix Private Detective Agency, a firm believer in tact and thrift. By tact, he means you can cheat all the people all the time and corners are there to be cut. By thrift, he means an underpaid staff is happy and grateful staff. By chance, he employs Lee Kwok Kit (Samuel Hui). Together, they have solved lots of wired cases. One day, while the two are investigating a blackmail case, the movie goes off and the lights come on. Scores of gun-toting hoods hold the more than 1,000 goers as hostages. On the stage Uncle Gaw (Shek Kin) threatens that it is a hold-up.

programme.title: 拳王
programme.desc: Silent classmate Ming, an ambitious boxing addict, decides to learn boxing in Thailand after a technical knockdown in a contest which he was confident of winning. By witnessing the rigorous training on the spot, he not only develops the physique of a boxer but enhances the dignity and dauntless spirit of the boxer in a tournament. Tak is another young upcoming boxer. He learned Chinese martial arts from his father since childhood. Not wanting to be cooped up in the narrow confines of boxing only, he undergoes hard training in Thai boxing in a gym, hoping to widen the boxing horizon..

programme.title: 爆谷星影好戲: 上天救命
programme.desc: Mak born unlucky, he is driven to despair after a series of depressing events and got himself into a car accident. As he passed out, his spirit went to hell where the devils told him that he will die after the deaths of the Millionaire Wong, Ms. Pao and Mr. Shek. Soon Mak came to his senses. At the same time, a big bag is thrown at him from a passing car. Inside it is the dead body of Millionaire Wong. Mak went to warn Pao only to find her murdered. Mak tried to convince Shek by telling him about the deaths of Millionaire Wong and Pao but Shek didn't believe him. In total desperation, Mak turned to Shek's sister for help. At midnight, Shek had a meeting..

programme.title: 猛鬼佛跳牆
programme.desc: It is a dream come true for engineer Bill Cheung when a quiet villa in the countryside is assigned to him as staff quarters. As soon as he moves into this extravagant estate with his wife and 2 daughters, strange things begin to happen. When his daughter Jane discovers the previous owners were burned to death many years ago, Bill's family is already on their way to a similar tragic demise..

programme.title: 一蚊雞保鑣
programme.desc: Bon Bon, a resident of Tuen Mun, who's always attempting to implement his latest pyramid scheme. Bon Bon rescues a lady from a lecher occasionally and decides to implement his latest scheme, 'One Dollar Bodyguard'. He'll protect women on their evening strolls for one HK dollar. Bon Bon has to attend to his own problem, which is his inability to ride in a moving vehicle, that strands him in Tuen Mun for life. And there's the romantic issue with Snooker to resolve..

programme.title: 阿飛正傳
programme.desc: A self-obsessed man, desperately seeking his true identity, York plays carelessly with his lovers and his friends before leaving them all to the Philippines in search of the truth..

programme.title: 知法犯法
programme.desc: Police constable Mike is suspended from duty charged with abusing the use of his gun in a robbery. During his suspension from duty, Mike meets a Triad Society Big Brother, Tin, and admires his lifestyle and also his sexy wife. Mike is apparently dismissed but in fact becoming a stoolie. Mike eventually becomes Tin's bodyguard, and discovers that his buddy Chung also becomes a stoolie. Mike uses the Police Force to get rid of all big brothers and intends to become the head of the Society, as well as taking over Tin's wife. For his own sake, Mike even kills his buddy Chung and kidnaps Tin..

programme.title: 影人映語 -鐵骨闖江湖 - 錢小豪
programme.desc: Being a well-known martial art movie star, Chin Siu Ho talks about his stories and personal feelings from such long journey. When got into acting since childhood, Siu Ho reveals that the encounter with Chang Cheh and Sammo Hung were the benefactors of his acting life and how he went through the mill to make action movies in the ‘80s. In particular, he has recalled his injury and hardship at the set of Hong Kong classic action-comedy ‘Mr. Vampire' that one of the scenes simply had him retaken for eight times! To know about the behind-the-scene of Hong Kong ‘80s action movies, let Siu Ho tell you more in this episode.

programme.title: 殭屍先生
programme.desc: Mr. Yan calls in Chinese voodoo priest Kou to handle the reburial of his dad. The corpse rises and becomes a vampire. It first kills Mr. Yan and roams about for new victims..

programme.title: 小男人周記
programme.desc: Leung Foon is one of those youthful, upward-moving people. He is 33, middle rung officer of an advertising agency, and has been married eight years to Ann. Ann holds down a key post in a finance company. She also likes to manage Foon's life. The couple has been drifting apart. A quarrel and the two decide to separate. Q-Taro and Big Cheat, Foon's colleagues and close friends, like to fool around. Q is married to the city shrew while Big Cheat's wife puts him above everything else. Foon has a new boss, Mrs. Lam who wants to rid the agency of useless employees. She forces Foon to fire Q-Taro..

programme.title: 影人映語 -電影旦—鄭丹瑞
programme.desc: Lawrence Cheng has been working in the film industry over 40 years who was known with his friends in the 1980s as the creator of The Yuppie Fantasia franchise. In this episode, Cheng shares his motive of creation and key to success of such franchise, as well as how he got obsessed with film as teen. Looking back, he admits that he was not a very competent director and reveals more unforgettable stories of the past.

programme.title: 紫雨風暴
programme.desc: On the eve of the inauguration of Hong Kong's new airport, a Korean cargo ship is found floating in the seas off Hong Kong, its crew murdered. The only survivor is Todd Nguyen, who is found unconscious on the vessel. When he awakes from his coma, he suffers from total amnesia. When it's discovered that Todd is a member of a Cambodian terrorist unit, an expert criminal psychiatrist convinces him that he is in fact an undercover agent sent to infiltrate the Cambodian organization..

programme.title: 最佳拍檔之千里救差婆
programme.desc: The invention of a prism - a special brain stimulant, gets King Kong and Inspector into a series of dangerous adventures. The lives of Inspector Ho and her son, Baldy Junior are also threatened by the villains..

programme.title: 絕代雙驕
programme.desc: Master, The of Eva Palace enters the valley in search of 10 Untouchable Villians. Despite being married and having a child together, she and Yin fight each other without remorse.

programme.title: 警察故事
programme.desc: Police officer Jackie is the hero in a police crackdown on drug king Chee. But Chee is set free on lack of evidence while Jackie is demoted. Chee, however, wants Jackie dead...

programme.title: 名劍
programme.desc: Swords, like diamonds, sometimes carry a curse. And the famous sword Chi Mud is such a sword. When swordmaster Wah acquires Chi Mud, he is advised to destroy it or he will be killed by this very sword. Wah does not listen. He has already retired into seclusion and does not think the young swordsmen can find and challenge him. Li is such a young swordsman. He even has dueled and killed another young challenger. Li by accident saves a young girl from a professional killer. In a few days, the girl and Li become friends. But the girl leaves in anger when Li meets his old flame Hsiao Yue, now married to Lin Wan. Li is ambushed by killer Chan..

programme.title: 驚天十二小時
programme.desc: Tarka Lama, a famous leader of religion in Asia and also a Chinese leader-in-exile, visits Singapore with his disciple/escort for a special mission. No sooner have they arrived the airport, Lama is assassinated in the welcoming ceremony..

programme.title: 黃蜂尾後針
programme.desc: When Yau argues with his wife Jessica for the uneven share of dirty money, he shoots her in coma. To find out the money, Yau hires Sister Ma to look after her..

programme.title: 偷神家族
programme.desc: Saint Hero is renowned for robbing the rich and giving to the poor. They uphold justice and fight crime. Che Hoi is head of Saint Hero with his odd couple daughters, Sim Lan and May as his assistants. All of them are excellent martial arts fighters. Without any trace of Saint Hero, Special Unit of the Police Force send their smartest man, Lethal Weapon, to cooperate with the most intelligent police woman, Super Canon. Another capable but odd couple swear to put Saint Hero to jail. However, they are the most capable but ‘destructive' police. All places that were under their investigation are badly ruined..

programme.title: 伊波拉病毒
programme.desc: Ten years ago, Kai, a local gangster was caught in bed with his boss's wife, he killed both the boss and his wife. The boss's daughter Lily witnessed the murders and managed to escape afterwards. As the police were looking for him, Kai was forced to disappear... For the last ten years, Kai has worked in a Chinese restaurant in Johannesburg in South Africa after being smuggled into the country. The restaurant owner Brother Kei and his wife Ling take advantage of Kai's situation and treat him badly. One day Kai goes to buy meat from a native tribe, he is unaware of that a terrible epidemic – the Ebola virus has broken out among the tribesmen. During the trip Kai rapes and murders a black girl who is infected with the disease. Kai has no idea he is carrying the disease, his body creates an antibody which means he is a carrier but the disease won't affect him..

programme.title: 鐵妹
programme.desc: The Story is set in the period during the Japanese invasion of China in the 1930's. A Chinese traitor Tung working within the puppet state of Manchukuo, gets involved in an affair with the mistress of a military officer. Their affair is exposed and in the confusion, Tung kills the officer and has to flee from the Japanese. In the desolate arid lands, his life is saved by Iron Sister, a member of guerrillas from a nearby hunting village, whom has an affair later with Tung. The humble villagers are very simple minded and only wished to drive out the Japanese. They fall easy prey, as Tung disguises his real identity and continues his secret contacts with his collaborators. One by one, the villagers become victims of Tung's ploy. Accidentally his plot is discovered by Iron Sister and they engage in a battle of life and death.

programme.title: 小男人周記
programme.desc: Leung Foon is one of those youthful, upward-moving people. He is 33, middle rung officer of an advertising agency, and has been married eight years to Ann. Ann holds down a key post in a finance company. She also likes to manage Foon's life. The couple has been drifting apart. A quarrel and the two decide to separate. Q-Taro and Big Cheat, Foon's colleagues and close friends, like to fool around. Q is married to the city shrew while Big Cheat's wife puts him above everything else. Foon has a new boss, Mrs. Lam who wants to rid the agency of useless employees. She forces Foon to fire Q-Taro..

programme.title: 龍在江湖
programme.desc: Brandon Ma, a regular guy working in Hong Kong, who is set up by his drug-dealing best friend Michael, to take the rap for the murder of an undercover cop. Michael also has eyes for Brandon's girl, May. While Brandon languishes in jail, May gives birth to their child and flees to Brazil to avoid the lurid clutches of Michael, who has become a big crime boss. Brandon gets out of prison after eight years, learns the truth, and goes after Michael for revenge..

programme.title: 倩女幽魂
programme.desc: A rainstorm compelled Ling to trespass Lan Po Temple for a night. Ling meets attractive Siu Seen. Being unaware of Lit's murder, he is madly in love with Siu Seen..

programme.desc: Tse-Ho works for the Triad, the deal in Taiwan turns out to be a trap by the Taiwanese gang. A shootout ensues in which Ho and Shing flee, pursued by local law enforcement. Ho's father is killed, he pleads with Kit to forgive his brother. Ho is released from prison three years later. Remorseful and determined to start a new life, he finds work as a driver for a taxi company, run by another ex-con. Ho spots Mark during one of his shifts; in contrast to Mark's letters, he realizes that Mark has been reduced to an errand boy for Shing (who is the new leader of the Triad). During an emotional reunion, Mark asks Ho to take revenge on Shing and reclaim their positions in the organization, but Ho refuses. Shing finds Ho and presses him to come back to his organization, offering to reinstate Mark if he returns. Ho flatly refuses. Consequently, Shing begins harassing Ho in order to get him to return, including luring Kit into a trap and injuring Kit, attacking Ho's co-workers, and hav.

programme.desc: Jackie assists the Duke for his exploration of the armour. In his latest hunt, he succeeded to acquire the 'sacred sword'. The terrorists kidnapped his friend in exchange..

programme.title: 至尊無上
programme.desc: Sam and Crab are a pair of skilled gamblers. When Sam chooses to leave the life, Crab engages the vengeful attention of Yakuza. The gangsters strike back by kidnapping Sam's girl..

programme.desc: On his hunting trip, Emperor Qi takes a wrong turn and is confronted by bandit leader/wild beauty Wu Yen. The two are immediately attracted to each other. However, an ugly mole on Wu Yen's face thwarts this match made in heaven. Emperor Qi cancels the wedding for fear of marrying someone ugly. The mole is the result of a 'love spell' put by enchantress Yin Chun, who is actually an incarnation of a 3000-years old fox with great magical power..

programme.desc: King Kong is commissioned by a man who claims to be Mr. Bond, special agent from the British Secret Service to recover for the Queen precious stones stolen from her crown which are now in Hong Kong. Back in Hong Kong, a Secret Service man from the Bond Street Headquarters, Mr. Tom Collins, has just arrived to find out a gang of notorious international crooks led by Mr. Bond. Carried out his mission successfully for Mr. Bond, King Kong is summoned by the Governor to assist Collins in retrieving the stolen goods and catch Mr. Bond's gang.

programme.desc: Hung is a Kung-fu coach on Lautau Island. His son Lung and his fellow schoolmate, Mao, are considered a couple. One time, Hung's fellow Yan goes to Lautau for help. Lung knows Yan is not a good guy, however, Hung orders Lung to accompany with Yan to develop his career in the city. Yan discovers that Lung is a talented snooker-player and earns much money from gambling. But Lung loses Hung's land to a group of gangsters in game..

Sheng discovers the loot has disappeared but the other three are convinced Sheng has stolen it. Sheng has to escape. His childhood lover Chuan tries to help him to go overseas but is hurt when Sheng falls for insurance detective Bonnie. Sheng and Bonnie buy tickets from Liang who is left holding the bag when his boss absconds with the money..

Frankie Chan immediately comes to the aid of his long time friend and in a series of exciting sequences they pursue Leon's missing fiance. Together they encounter her father's bumbling gangster, the vivaciously devious Sharon Kwok, and a team of deadly western agents sent to destroy them. In an explosive finale laughter takes a backseat to tension as the two battle overwhelming odds and just when all appears lost Frankie comes to the rescue.

The robbery ends in bloodshed. Inspector Fujioka's assistant is shot to death at the crime scene. The couple takes the jewelry to Hong Kong and Fujioka follows their trail. Madam Yang of the Hong Kong Police is assigned to help him. However, Yang's superior and uncle intervenes the investigation. Fujioka is tired of such power struggle and decides to act on his own accord..

programme.desc: Former criminal, Tse-Ho is set free from his incarceration in jail to assist in the investigation of his former crime boss, Lung, who is suspected of running a counterfeit operation. Though initially refusing, he only agrees so he can keep a close eye on his cop brother Kit, who is working undercover to infiltrate Lung's organization. After Lung is framed for the murder of a rival gang leader, he turns to Tse-Ho, who helps him escape to New York where he is joined by Ken, the equally deadly twin brother of the deceased Mark. Returning to Hong Kong to rejoin Tse-Ho and Kit, they soon discover the true mastermind behind the entire operation, and in true John Woo fashion, set out to take him down.

programme.desc: Though persuaded by his brother, Chicken Wing, Kit refused to gamble again. However, Tommy keeps on harassing them, Kit finally decided to take revenge..

programme.desc: Advertising professional Alex, just breaks up with his model girlfriend Peggy. In order to release Alex's anxiety, his friend invites him to be the part time director of a choir. Alex meets Vivian in the choir. However, Vivian's mother Chu Lai Ngo, a divorced woman who dislikes Alex at the first sight. When Alex and Chu are getting closer and closer, they imperceptibly fall in love with each other. At this moment, Peggy suddenly comes back to Alex asking for being together once again. Alex has to make his choice of love between these two women..

programme.desc: Yuan Ling-yu, men looked at her with dreamy eyes and women looked at her sideways and full of hate. And her endings were tragic : mental breakdown, forced marriages and suicide..

programme.desc: FBI Cindy is ordered to Hong Kong to get the leader of counterfeit banknote manufacturing syndicate, Huang Te. In Hong Kong, Huang goes into the printing business. Ostensibly, he publishes a newspaper. But his real business is still the forgoing of banknotes. Cindy gets a job as the paper's reporter but alert Hong Kong police tell her to keep off. It is their job to get Huang. Cindy happens to know her friend's father is the prosecutor in Huang's trial. She tries to help but Huang gets off by poisoning the prosecutor. Now Cindy is desperate. The police want to see her back in America. She wants to get Huang herself..

programme.desc: Lung was an informer of Police in the triad society. But his identity was exposed and lost all memory after hurt. All of money that given by the Police was lost. The Police suspicious Lung had hidden the money. So he was wanted by the triad society and Police. Sing was a little thief, he knew Lung and made friend together. He knew everything about Lung then, and he wanted to help Lung to recover his memory aimed to take back the money. Fong was a manger in a big firm. He had stolen a large amount of money of his firm and was discovered by his colleague later. So he wanted to kill Wu but failed. Fong also wanted the money of Lung, as a result, he wanted to kill Lung also. Wu was saved by Lung and Sing. The Boss of Fong knew everything were exposed and ordered Koo to kill Lung, Sing and Wu. But Wu won't do that because of their friendship..

programme.title: 天若有情
programme.desc: Wah Dee handles cars and bikes like a racing champion. To keep the police off his trail, he takes Jo Jo hostage. On the run, their desperate love is doomed from the start...

programme.title: 阿金
programme.desc: Ah Kam is from Mainland China and is trained in kung fu. She becomes a double in Hong Kong. Tung and his partners of the Tung's Family, a stunt man group, cannot work as stuntmen after an ambush. Tung lets Kam try being the stunt director and Kam becomes very popular. Kam married Sam and moves to Shenzhen to look after Sam's karaoke business. However, being a karaoke manager does not suit Kam. At the same time, Sam is unfaithful and so Kam returns to the movie industry and once again becomes a stuntwoman..

programme.desc: Office worker Amy goes berserk and tries to stab her boss, Cheuk, accusing him of sexual harassment and rape. The higher-ups accept Amy's description of the event and Cheuk is suspended, in spite of the fact that in-house lawyer Joe believes the man is innocent..

programme.desc: David is a young lawyer who launders money for a gang leader in Chinatown. He is robbed and his assistant got killed when he carries a large sum of cash to Hong Kong. David turns to Waise, his law school buddy, for help. He doesn't realize that it is Waise who sets up the robbery. Petty, Waise's partner in the law firm, finds out that Waise has conducted some illegal activities. Before she could unveil the truth to the police, Petty is murdered. To cover up the truth, Waise finds Mandy, a promising solicitor, as scapegoat of Petty's death. Waise also sends out a gunman to track down Mandy. In a last minute rescue, Mandy is saved by one of her client, Dragon. She always finds the client obnoxious, but now she has to team up with Dragon to fight back and to prove her innocence at the same time..

programme.desc: Leung Chiu Wei and Willy were cartoonists. One day when they were on the way to office, they knocked down a lady-ghost Joey Wong. Joey's spirit was thus thrown into the human world. Joey knew nothing as it was the first time she came to a mundane environment. At this time, she met another demoness – Deanie Yip. Yip and her son were sentenced to death by village people because of adultery. Yip didn't do it but nobody believed her. Yip's only hope was to make her son revive from death. Thus when Yip met Willy, she selfishly kept herself and her son inspired by Willy's human spirit. She also intended to hurt Wei the same as well. Since Joey had fallen in love with Wei, she helped Wei to get away from Yip. Joey became weaker and weaker being hurt by Wei's flourishing human vitality. Wei and Joey in fact were lovers in their previous lives..

He is suffering until he comes across the school teacher Miss Ho. Sing's school life is thus painted with more colours. Finally, Sing settles every problem and succeeds in finding the lost gun. At the Same Time, he destorys a munition smuggling activity. This leads the smugglers to school to take revenge. A group of students is being kept hostage. Sing shows his true colour by saving all the students. This not only wins his students' admiration but also Miss Ho's heart.

Aran is forced to marry Connie. Aran and Connie visit Japan for their honeymoon. It is where Aran learns of the scheme and meets Atsuko who really steals his heart..

programme.title: Recipe For Love
programme.desc: In Onjeong Market, located in Onjeong, a town some distance away from Seoul, the area is buzzing with change as apartment complexes are built and plans for subway extensions and new town developments are announced. Across a single street stand a principled general hospital, Gongmyeongjeongdae Clinic, and traditional Korean clinic, Yangji Barun Clinic. The two families who run these places have been bitter enemies for years, bound by a long standing grudge from an incident in the past. Even the smallest matters turn into big fights, making them the most famous rival families in Onjeong. This is a family growth drama about these two families as they unravel their long held misunderstandings, heal their wounds, learn to love one another, and are reborn as one family.

programme.title: Noona, You Are A Woman To Me
programme.desc: Age is just a number-attraction is pure instinct. Charismatic “Noonas” (older women) who have long put love on hold to pursue their careers meet younger men who fearlessly follow their hearts, sparking emotionally driven romances. Breaking through the real-world barriers of age differences, this bold and candid reality series follows older-woman–younger-man couples as they explore love with honesty and courage. As their relationships unfold, long-dormant romantic instincts are awakened in this refreshingly daring dating reality show.

programme.title: 蔣英實
programme.desc: The drama is the first 'historic science' drama that has been produced in Korea. This drama depicts the successful life story of the scientist Jang Youngsil that contributed to the development and accomplishment of Joseon's science during the 15th century. In particular, the drama emphasizes his accomplishment through showing the restrictions and difficulties he experienced due to his social class as a slave. Moreover, the drama aims to depict Jang Youngsil as the role model of 'Korea's youth of the 21st century' through displaying his scientific accomplishments. The drama also expects to stimulate scientific curiosity amongst audiences and help them easily understand the fundamental principles of science by utilizing various data and scientific videos.

programme.title: 蔣英實
programme.desc: The drama is the first 'historic science' drama that has been produced in Korea. This drama depicts the successful life story of the scientist Jang Youngsil that contributed to the development and accomplishment of Joseon's science during the 15th century. In particular, the drama emphasizes his accomplishment through showing the restrictions and difficulties he experienced due to his social class as a slave. Moreover, the drama aims to depict Jang Youngsil as the role model of 'Korea's youth of the 21st century' through displaying his scientific accomplishments. The drama also expects to stimulate scientific curiosity amongst audiences and help them easily understand the fundamental principles of science by utilizing various data and scientific videos.

programme.title: 蔣英實
programme.desc: The drama is the first 'historic science' drama that has been produced in Korea. This drama depicts the successful life story of the scientist Jang Youngsil that contributed to the development and accomplishment of Joseon's science during the 15th century. In particular, the drama emphasizes his accomplishment through showing the restrictions and difficulties he experienced due to his social class as a slave. Moreover, the drama aims to depict Jang Youngsil as the role model of 'Korea's youth of the 21st century' through displaying his scientific accomplishments. The drama also expects to stimulate scientific curiosity amongst audiences and help them easily understand the fundamental principles of science by utilizing various data and scientific videos.

programme.title: Recipe For Love
programme.desc: In Onjeong Market, located in Onjeong, a town some distance away from Seoul, the area is buzzing with change as apartment complexes are built and plans for subway extensions and new town developments are announced. Across a single street stand a principled general hospital, Gongmyeongjeongdae Clinic, and traditional Korean clinic, Yangji Barun Clinic. The two families who run these places have been bitter enemies for years, bound by a long standing grudge from an incident in the past. Even the smallest matters turn into big fights, making them the most famous rival families in Onjeong. This is a family growth drama about these two families as they unravel their long held misunderstandings, heal their wounds, learn to love one another, and are reborn as one family.

programme.desc: In the first part of the episode, Andy explores sustainable kingfish farming in Spencer Gulf, South Australia, visiting Clean Seas sea farm and preparing fresh kingfish sashimi with the team.
